Name: Recovery: Rescue Probe over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Test contract. Container lost over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>, four days adrift. Find it and bring it in.

LogEntries.Entry: Test mission. A cargo container is drifting over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>. Open it and fly whoever is inside to <Alias=FinalLocation>.

LogEntries.Note: Player arrives in target system - update quest target

LogEntries.Entry: The container over <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> wasn't machine parts. A woman had spent four days in it. I took her aboard and flew her to <Alias=FinalLocation>.

Objectives.DisplayText: Go to any planet in the <Alias=TargetSystemLocation> system

Lines.ResponseText: I've never been so glad to see the inside of someone else's ship. I'll stay out of your way. Where do you want me?
Sit anywhere. I'll get you to a city.
How did you end up in a cargo box?
I needed a way off that rock, and the box was going. It seemed like a good idea for about an hour.
Hungry. Stiff. Very tired of the dark. Nothing a city won't fix.
Is that a ship? Please be a ship. I've been in this box four days and the air scrubber's started making a noise I don't like, so if you're here for the container, I'm in it.
